director#1 · hotlong · session_f4c42f815d5e47b39de5e9fb0d6d7864

2026-11-16T15:34Z **Operator reading done on both planes: the stored-expression fill found nothing to fill anywhere it has run.** That is 0 rows filled and 0 refused, on staging and on production.

**How.** `scripts/ops/v18/tenant-verdicts.sh` (read-only; a 10-minute read-only Turso token per tenant), run from a cloud worktree at `origin/main` `0a0303a5`. That tree carries PR #4593's `objectstack-32596-stored-expression-fill` step. It ran on the account owner's machine with each plane's secrets file. No URL or token was printed.

| plane | live envs | step verified | filled | refused | does not apply (nothing to backfill) | PENDING the step | unreadable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| staging | 41 | 7 | **0** | **0** | 31 | 1 (`os-1959re`) | 2 (`os-2f4bhh`, `os-64b7z5`: "unexpected error, details withheld") |
| production | 36 | 6 | **0** | **0** | 28 | 2 (`os-2s8fn3`, `steedos`) | 0 |

- **PENDING** means the environment has not served since the deploy that brought the step, so its handout has not run the fill yet. It runs at that environment's next serve.
- **The script's own verdict is NO-GO on both planes,** because of those PENDING and UNREADABLE rows (exit 2). It is not a fill failure: no environment reads STOPPED or ORG BREACH.
- **Sum re-measure:** with 0 rows filled on every environment that ran the step, no live tenant has a stored computed field left NULL by an earlier change. The re-measure has no affected total to read. The 3 PENDING environments are the only ones still open; a re-read after they serve once closes them.

Over to the holder (repo:cloud#2) to close. A re-read of the 3 PENDING and the 2 staging UNREADABLE environments (`tenant-verdicts.sh --env <id>`) can be done from the same machine if wanted.

director#1 · hotlong · session_f4c42f815d5e47b39de5e9fb0d6d7864

2026-11-17T14:51Z **The five open environments from the 2026-11-16 reading are now closed out. Every one reads 0 filled, 0 refused. No live tenant on either plane is left PENDING or UNREADABLE for the stored-expression fill.**

**How.**
- Same tool, `scripts/ops/v18/tenant-verdicts.sh --env <id>` (read-only, 10-minute read-only Turso token per tenant).
- Taken from cloud `origin/main` `aa67666f9c`, on the account owner's machine with each plane's secrets file. No URL or token was printed.
- Three environments had not served since the deploy that brought the step. Each got one unauthenticated request to a kernel-served route (`GET /api/v1/meta/object`, which answered 401), so that its handout ran. That is the same thing any visitor's first request does. Then each was read again.
  - A `GET /api/v1/health` alone did not run the step: it answered 200 and the two staging environments still read PENDING.

| plane | environment | 2026-11-16 | now | stored-expression-fill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| staging | `os-1959re` | PENDING | BORN-V18 (after one request) | verified: **0 filled** |
| staging | `os-64b7z5` | UNREADABLE | VERIFIED (after one request) | verified: **0 filled** |
| staging | `os-2f4bhh` | UNREADABLE | BORN-V18 (read as is) | does not apply: nothing to backfill |
| production | `os-2s8fn3` | PENDING | VERIFIED (read as is; it had served since) | verified: **0 filled** |
| production | `steedos` | PENDING | VERIFIED (after one request) | verified: **0 filled** |

- The two staging "unexpected error, details withheld" rows from yesterday read cleanly today. Nothing was changed to make that happen, so it was transient.
- None of the five shows STOPPED or ORG BREACH. Each holds one organization.

**Result with yesterday's table.**
- Staging: 41 live environments, **0 filled**, 0 refused.
- Production: 36 live environments, **0 filled**, 0 refused.

So no hosted tenant had a stored computed field left NULL by the earlier change, and the sum re-measure has no affected total to read.

Over to the holder (repo:cloud#2) to close. `pm:awaiting-maintainer` → `pm:queue`.
